images.alt: Poster for Basement Protocol. Headline: Fifty basslines. Built for the basement. A piano roll shows pattern BP44 Acid Rain, a one-bar acid line in A Phrygian at 130 BPM, with glowing slide curves between notes. Stats read 50 MIDI files, 700 notes, 7 groove families, above the site address.

Vertical story card. Headline: 50 free bassline MIDI files. A tall piano roll shows the first bar of pattern BP11 Marrow, a rolling four-bar line in A Phrygian at 128 BPM. Stats and a button-style label read: Tap the link to open the lab.
Carousel slide 1 of 5. Headline: 50 free bassline MIDI files. Built for the basement. Small piano rolls from four patterns run across the slide, with a prompt to swipe.
Carousel slide 2 of 5. Seven groove families with a bar for how many patterns each holds: sparse 7, rolling 8, offbeat 7, syncopated 8, staccato 7, sustained 6, acid 7.
Carousel slide 3 of 5. Headline: Every note is in the file. A large piano roll of BP44 Acid Rain with its slides highlighted, plus its key, tempo, length, and note count.
Carousel slide 4 of 5. Headline: Validated like software. Three results with check marks: 12 of 12 checks pass, a second parser agrees on all 700 notes, byte-identical on every rebuild.
Carousel slide 5 of 5. A phone screenshot of the pattern lab playing BP44 Acid Rain. Text: Audition every file in your browser. Then drag the .mid into your DAW. Free. The site address is below.
Vertical cover. Headline: Every note is in the file. A piano roll of BP44 Acid Rain with slide curves. Text: 50 free bassline MIDI files. The soundtrack is played from the pack itself. Link in bio.
Thumbnail with oversized text: 50 free basslines, MIDI. A speaker cone glows on the right behind a short acid piano roll.
Channel banner. The Basement Protocol logo and name, the line 50 free bassline MIDI files, and the site address, centered over a dark strip of piano rolls from four patterns.

Wide card. Headline: 50 free bassline MIDI files. Subhead: Real 1, 2, and 4-bar loops with tempo and key inside. Validated like software. On the right, a piano roll of BP44 Acid Rain with glowing slides.
Profile header. Basement Protocol logo and name, 50 free bassline MIDI files, and the site address over a strip of piano rolls.

Feed poster. Headline: Seven groove families. Fifty loops. A bar chart counts patterns per family: sparse 7, rolling 8, offbeat 7, syncopated 8, staccato 7, sustained 6, acid 7. The site address is at the bottom.

images.alt: Link preview card. Headline: 50 free bassline MIDI files. Subhead: Audition every file in your browser. Validated like software. A piano roll of BP44 Acid Rain is on the right.

Feed poster. Headline: A MIDI pack, validated like software. A panel lists validation checks with check marks, including parsing, tempo and meter, loop boundaries, pitch range, monophony, and a second parser comparing all 700 notes. Stats read 50 MIDI files, 700 notes, 7 groove families.
Profile cover. Basement Protocol logo and name, 50 free bassline MIDI files, and the site address on the right over a strip of piano rolls.

Infographic pin titled 7 groove families, 50 free bassline MIDI files. Each family has a short description, a pattern count, and a small piano roll of one real pattern: BP07 Grime Pulse, BP08 Gallop Protocol, BP21 Double Offbeat, BP23 Tresillo Grind, BP33 Morse Floor, BP42 Cinder Drone, and BP46 Resonance Riot.
Pattern spotlight for BP44 Acid Rain: a full one-bar piano roll with accent notes and slide curves, and a data panel listing A Phrygian, 130 BPM, 1 bar, 14 notes, acid family, legato slides.

Feed poster. Headline: Hear it before you download it. A piano roll shows BP29 Clave Dread, a one-bar syncopated line in B flat Phrygian at 122 BPM. Stats read 50 MIDI files, 700 notes, 7 groove families.

Square card titled Validated like software. Twelve validation checks are listed with check marks, from 50 files with matching IDs through to the ZIP matching the validated files byte for byte. The footer reads 12 of 12 pass and gives the site address.
